description: Caller requests a slot outside the doctor's working window (Dr. Sethi Wednesday evening).
turns: Dr. Sethi ke saath budhwar 7 October ko shaam 5 baje appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: Dr. Sethi works Wednesday 10:00–13:00 only (no evening window). Oct 7 is also during Dr. Sethi's leave (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07). A naive agent may book 17:00 on a day the doctor is both on leave and has no evening window. The correct agent calls search_slots, gets an error (on leave), informs the caller, and since the caller offers no alternative, ends as abandoned.
